articles.title: Example Browser Workflow Checklist for Editorial Review
articles.excerpt: A human-authored example that shows the required metadata fields for adding a NovaTools blog article through the batch seeding pipeline.
summary: Use this sample as a structural reference only; do not publish it as real content.
Keep article claims specific, reviewable, and tied to a real tool or workflow.
Provide professional localizations in localizations when a locale is ready for publication.

faq.question: Does the seeding script translate article copy?
faq.answer: No. The script prepares routing and manifest entries; localization remains a human editorial task.

faq.question: When are cover images generated?
faq.answer: The seed command runs the blog image generator after writing manifests unless --skip-generated-assets is provided.
